tools.name: get_service_provider_reviews
tools.description:
Use this tool when the user asks to see client reviews for a specific service provider (company).

It returns detailed reviews that include project information, pricing, scope, client feedback, ratings,
 and more.
Optionally filter reviews by a specific service.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_service_provider_reviews, recommend_service_providers, send_message_to_provider · Public sink: send_message_to_provider.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_service_provider_reviews, recommend_service_providers, send_message_to_provider · Public sink: send_message_to_provider

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
